title: Freeze the No. 10 and pandemic-data personnel diaspora
bounded_action: Enumerate the complete official-source cohort before querying later destinations; build dated public and private role transitions, appointment restrictions, matched controls, nulls, and identity holds without converting broad institutions into hops.
privacy_handling: Use public roles and public-interest appointments only; exclude private-life, protected-trait, contact, address, and family data.

title: Reconstruct 10DS, i.AI, GDS, and DSIT institutional succession
bounded_action: Freeze every formally named central-government data or AI unit, mandate, budget, leader, programme, supplier, transfer, closure, merger, and matched international comparator; keep narrative similarity separate from receipted inheritance.
privacy_handling: Use official institutional and public-role records; do not ingest private staff data or identity-adjacent attributes.

title: Trace Faculty capabilities through the Accenture acquisition
bounded_action: Reconstruct the transaction, legal entities, products, personnel, contracts, frameworks, customers, and post-acquisition placement; identify what demonstrably transferred, continued, expired, or remained merely marketed as continuity.
privacy_handling: Restrict collection to public company, product, contract, and public-role records; exclude private employee and customer information.

title: Map commercialisation of pandemic decision infrastructure
bounded_action: Enumerate pandemic-era population-response, testing, forecasting, dashboard, logistics, behavioural, and executive-decision capabilities from official sources, then trace products, companies, acquisitions, patents, grants, and later deployments under identity-grade rules.
privacy_handling: Do not retain patient, test-subject, contact, or other sensitive pandemic data; use programme, supplier, and public-role facts only.

title: Audit the validator-to-adviser scientific legitimacy market
bounded_action: Freeze every vendor validation claim and named evaluator, then reconstruct role, compensation, protocol control, publication, replication, and disclosure chronology across the complete vendor denominator.
privacy_handling: Use professional roles, public conflicts, publications, and company records; exclude private compensation or personal data not publicly disclosed and material.

title: Map the Centre for Human Progress behavioural-science bridge
bounded_action: Freeze legal governance, directors, programmes, publications, grants, donors where lawfully disclosed, events, consultancies, policy outputs, and formal company relationships; keep shared directorship separate from transaction evidence.
privacy_handling: Use public organisational, professional, grant, and programme records; exclude private donors where disclosure is restricted and private participant information.

title: Audit former-official AI advisory portfolios and controls
bounded_action: Define the cohort by prior office, collect every approved or disclosed appointment and restriction, and screen restriction-window lobbying, procurement, meetings, bids, grants, and enforcement under date and identity gates.
privacy_handling: Use public offices, appointments, restrictions, government contacts, and enforcement records; exclude private client or family information unless lawfully disclosed and essential.

title: Freeze the analyst-made synthetic-population category
bounded_action: Recover the complete reviewed and watched vendor universes, report methodology, tier logic, vendor reproductions, procurement reliance, and category changes without treating watch-list inclusion as endorsement or superiority.
privacy_handling: Use company, analyst, customer, and procurement records; exclude private analyst-client material unless lawfully public.

title: Build the publisher synthetic-audience deployment corpus
bounded_action: Enumerate publisher and media deployments, classify logos and reciprocal confirmations, and document contracting entities, datasets, lawful roles, internal users, advertiser access, decisions, human research, complaints, and regulator outcomes.
privacy_handling: Do not reproduce subscriber, panel, advertiser, or individual-level data; record dataset classes, legal roles, and public policies only.

title: Classify modelled populations replacing observed consultation
bounded_action: Identify documented workflows and classify supplementation, screening, partial substitution, full replacement, and hypothetical capability; record affected populations, decision stakes, disclosure, appeal, override, and matched human controls.
privacy_handling: Use process-level and public policy evidence; minimise affected-person and vulnerable-group information and never infer individual views from synthetic output.

title: Search political persuasion and message-optimisation use
bounded_action: Freeze political capability and acceptable-use claims, then search official campaign, lobbying, procurement, grant, consultancy, advertising, and client records; keep capability, sales, pilot, contract, expenditure, and deployment distinct.
privacy_handling: Use public campaigns, organisations, expenditures, contracts, and political-advertising records; exclude voter-level, contact, and protected-trait data.

title: Search government, classified, and defence deployment
bounded_action: Build legal-name and reseller identity bundles, run complete official procurement and grant matrices, and distinguish supplier listing, bid, award, subcontract, pilot, grant, deployment, accreditation, and claimed classified readiness.
privacy_handling: Use public procurement, award, supplier, grant, and security statements; exclude protected operational details and personal security information.

title: Map synthetic-data lineage, consent, and anonymisation
bounded_action: Inventory data sources, legal roles, purposes, consent or lawful basis, retention, rights, anonymisation and re-identification tests, and distinguish model training, persona construction, calibration, validation, and customer operation.
privacy_handling: Do not reproduce personal, panel, subscriber, health, employee, voter, or broker data; record legal and technical metadata at the minimum necessary level.

title: Govern metrics and benchmarks for synthetic populations
bounded_action: Freeze every quantitative claim, metric, benchmark, holdout, baseline, model version, subgroup result, leakage control, error distribution, correction, and replication; report per-question and tail failures rather than only headline percentages.
privacy_handling: Use aggregate evaluation materials and public benchmark metadata; do not expose respondent-level holdouts or restricted datasets.

title: Test cross-cultural and multilingual extrapolation
bounded_action: Separate country and language availability, data support, localisation, validation, deployment, uncertainty, subgroup error, abstention, and unsupported-market warnings across the complete vendor denominator.
privacy_handling: Use aggregate country and language evidence; minimise protected-class and vulnerable-group data and prohibit identity-adjacent scoring.

title: Map foundation-model, cloud, and subprocessor dependence
bounded_action: Archive subprocessor, security, DPA, trust-centre, status, model-provider, cloud-region, incident, certification, and version-change records; test whether validation is rerun after material upstream changes.
privacy_handling: Record technical and contractual metadata only; do not expose credentials, security-sensitive architecture, customer content, prompts, or personal data.

title: Resolve capital, board control, and strategic rights
bounded_action: Build legal-entity bundles and reconcile funding announcements with filed allotments, securities, currencies, tranches, directors, observers, PSCs, consent rights, charges, acquisitions, and recurring investors across the frozen vendor cohort.
privacy_handling: Use public company, fund, securities, and governance records; exclude private shareholder details not lawfully disclosed and unnecessary personal data.

title: Measure labour substitution and professional research duties
bounded_action: Classify task-level assistance, acceleration, automation, consolidation, replacement, retraining, and new work; compare productivity and workforce claims with professional codes, human accountability, matched workflows, and verified employment effects.
privacy_handling: Use aggregate workforce, public job, procurement, professional-standard, and employer records; exclude employee personal data and unsupported causation.
